package fixture

// GREEN: the annotated form. `_ =` makes it an assignment rather than an
// expression statement, which is the whole of what the rule reads.

import "context"

type proc interface{ Stop(context.Context) error }

type dest struct{ proc proc }

func teardown(p proc, d *dest, ctx context.Context) {
	// Deliberately discarded: there is nothing else this path can do.
	_ = p.Stop(ctx)
	_ = d.proc.Stop(ctx)
}
